rendersnap.option.gentle_workers.tooltip:
What: chunk build workers run at below-normal CPU priority and sleep instead of spinning while they wait for upload space.
Benefit: the render thread wins CPU time, so fewer stutters while chunks load.
Cost: chunk loading can be slightly slower on a fully busy CPU.
Applies: waiting immediately; priority after restarting Minecraft.
rendersnap.option.rebuild_guard.tooltip:
What: limits chunk rebuilds on the render thread to about 2 ms per frame; the first one always runs at once and the rest go to background workers.
Benefit: removes big frame spikes from explosions, /fill, pistons and flowing water near you.
Cost: when many blocks change at once, some update a frame or two later.
Applies: immediately; only matters when Chunk Builder is Semi Blocking or Fully Blocking.
rendersnap.option.light_pacing.tooltip:
What: when 1000+ light updates are queued (joining, teleporting, fast flight), applies them over a few frames instead of all in one frame.
Benefit: removes the freeze frame vanilla causes during big light floods.
Cost: newly loaded chunks can look darker for a moment while light catches up.
Applies: immediately.
rendersnap.option.fps.tooltip:
What: shows an FPS readout over the HUD.
Benefit: none; this is a diagnostic display.
Cost: a tiny HUD draw each frame.
Applies: immediately.
rendersnap.option.zoom_cinematic.tooltip:
What: turns on vanilla's smooth (cinematic) camera while zooming.
Benefit: steadier aim when fully zoomed in.
Cost: the view trails behind the mouse and feels floaty.
Applies: next zoom.
rendersnap.option.zoom_ease.tooltip:
What: controls the zoom transition curve.
Benefit: none; visual preference only.
Cost: none worth measuring.
Applies: immediately.
rendersnap.option.liquid_fix.tooltip:
What: freezes animated liquid frames in the block atlas.
Benefit: removes repeated liquid animation updates.
Cost: other animated block textures may also freeze.
Applies: immediately.
rendersnap.option.shadow_fix.tooltip:
What: skips entity shadow extraction while the camera is turning quickly.
Benefit: reduces camera-turn frame spikes.
Cost: shadows briefly disappear during fast turns.
Applies: immediately.
rendersnap.option.entities.tooltip:
What: hides non-player entities more than 8 chunks away when their chunk section is hidden behind terrain (not visible from your camera).
Benefit: lowers entity render work, e.g. mobs in caves far below you.
Cost: a far entity can appear one frame late when it comes into view.
Applies: immediately; vanilla renderer only.
rendersnap.option.shadow_reuse.tooltip:
What: reuses a computed entity shadow only during the same client game tick when entity position and camera distance are identical.
Benefit: avoids duplicate block and light sampling on high-FPS frames.
Cost: none expected; the cache expires before the next client tick.
Applies: immediately.
rendersnap.option.fast_launch.tooltip:
What: pauses Rendersnap's visual reductions for five seconds after joining a world.
Benefit: avoids aggressive cuts while chunks first stream in.
Cost: no direct FPS boost during the warm-up.
Applies: next world join.
rendersnap.option.chunk_pacing.tooltip:
What: asks vanilla to deprioritize chunk updates that are not player-affected.
Benefit: can reduce rebuild spikes while travelling.
Cost: distant block changes can appear later.
Applies: immediately; restores your prior vanilla priority when disabled.
rendersnap.option.chunk_workers.tooltip:
What: sets the number of dedicated CPU workers Rendersnap gives to vanilla chunk mesh compilation.
Benefit: lower values reserve CPU time for gameplay; higher values build chunks faster.
Cost: too many workers can cause frame-time spikes on smaller CPUs.
Applies: after restarting Minecraft.
rendersnap.option.chunk_shade_trim.toolt:
What: omits ambient-occlusion shading for chunk blocks at least 128 blocks away.
Benefit: reduces far chunk rebuild cost.
Cost: distant blocks look flatter.
Applies: refreshes chunk meshes.
rendersnap.option.fog_occlusion.tooltip:
What: omits non-solid chunk layers once vanilla fog fully covers them.
Benefit: lowers transparent-layer draw work in heavy fog.
Cost: fog edges can look less smooth with some resource packs.
Applies: immediately; vanilla renderer only.
rendersnap.option.cave_culling.tooltip:
What: skips distant underground sections that are strongly behind the camera.
Benefit: lowers hidden cave terrain work.
Cost: aggressive turns can reveal a section one frame late.
Applies: immediately; vanilla renderer only.
rendersnap.option.weather.tooltip:
What: removes rain and snow columns from the renderer.
Benefit: lowers particle and weather draw cost.
Cost: precipitation is no longer visible.
Applies: immediately.
rendersnap.option.behind_cam.tooltip:
What: skips far translucent-section resorting behind the camera.
Benefit: reduces transparent-layer CPU work while turning.
Cost: distant water and glass can update late after a fast turn.
Applies: immediately; vanilla renderer only.
rendersnap.toast.reload.title: Reload the chunk
rendersnap.toast.reload.body: Press F3+A if an existing chunk keeps its previous appearance.

rendersnap.toast.restart.body: Chunk build worker changes apply after restarting Minecraft.

rendersnap.toast.benchmark.failed.body: The benchmark report could not be written.
